scope: Release 0.8.0 is pinned because its documented libcurl minimum is 8.10.0, compatible with the pinned Debian libcurl 8.14.1-2+deb13u7; current main requires 8.20.0. The original FPM library and C helpers are unchanged. The example adapts examples/url/url.f90 and checks successful URL parsing plus exact host, path, port and query strings, changes the path and checks the reconstructed URL. The C URL handle is released and cleared by the caller, following the 0.8 cleanup semantics. N3 describes parsing/constructing character data. No network request is made; sandbox internet access remains disabled. HTTP transfers, authentication, mail protocols and other libcurl facilities are not runtime-verified. ISC notices are retained.
configuration: Release 0.8.0 requires libcurl >=8.10 and is checked against pinned libcurl 8.14.1. Only offline URL operations were exercised.
